notes: Adds automatic IP-blocking for abusive requests to the Free Service Gateway API: any request whose link/service value is absurdly long (over 300 characters - no real link is ever close to that) is now rejected immediately and, when Auto-block is enabled in Gateway Settings, the sender's IP is blocked right away instead of waiting for the existing 5-minute volume-based sweep, using the same escalating block-duration rules as repeat offenders. No database update needed for this update.
